name: Pizzeria Venezia
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Venezia in Maurach** – Enjoy authentic Italian flair in the heart of Tirol! Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy pizzeria invites you to savor freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and delicious antipasti in a warm, rustic setting. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Salami** pizza, every bite is a taste of Italy. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu** for dessert—pure indulgence! Perfect for families, couples, or a quick bite after exploring the stunning **Inntal** or the charming village of **Maurach**. Open daily, with a relaxed atmosphere and friendly service. A must-visit for pizza lovers in the region!
